display.purpose: Hero headlines and campaign titles. Syne 800 only. Never on interactive elements.

headline.purpose: Page titles, section headings, dashboard H1s. Syne 700.

title.purpose: Card names, modal headings, sub-sections. DM Sans 600.

body.purpose: Descriptions, helper text, prose. DM Sans 400. Max 65ch.

label.purpose: Badges, chips, table headers, uppercase tags. DM Sans 700.

shadows.name: hover-lift

shadows.name: focus-ring

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Used for Add to Cart, Checkout, Login, Register Sale.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #00704A; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 112, 74, 0.25); transition: background 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease; min-height: 44px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #005A3B; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 112, 74, 0.35); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 112, 74, 0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00704A; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions. Used alongside a primary CTA (e.g. Ir al inicio next to Ver mis pedidos).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #1E3932; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid #E5E7EB; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; min-height: 44px; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #00704A; background: #D4E9E2; color: #00704A; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00704A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(30, 57, 50, 0.1); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; background: #F9F9F9; } .ds-card-body { padding: 10px 12px 14px; } .ds-card-badge { display: inline-block; background: #D4E9E2; color: #00704A; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-brand { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1E3932; opacity: 0.5; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin: 0 0 2px; } .ds-card-name { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1E3932; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-card-price { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; color: #00704A; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-stock { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #1E3932; opacity: 0.4; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Used for search, forms, filters.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1.5px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 400; color: #1E3932; padding: 12px 16px; outline: none; min-height: 48px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #1E3932; opacity: 0.35; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #00704A; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 112, 74, 0.12); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid #E5E7EB; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; } .ds-nav-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-logo-icon { background: #00704A; border-radius: 10px; width: 32px; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-logo-name { font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 800; color: #1E3932; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(30,57,50,0.75); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link--active { color: #00704A; } .ds-nav-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #00704A; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 9999px; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,112,74,0.2); transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: #005A3B; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,112,74,0.3); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Catalog filter pills. Used for brand, type, condition, price range.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid #E5E7EB; background: transparent; color: #1E3932; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 0.15s ease; min-height: 36px; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #00704A; background: #D4E9E2; color: #00704A; } .ds-chip--active { background: #00704A; border-color: #00704A; color: #ffffff; } .ds-chip--active:hover { background: #005A3B; border-color: #005A3B; }

narrative.overview:
TechPhone looks and feels like the store owner is standing right there: informed, direct, with prices that don't hide. No loading animation theater, no decorative gradients, no aspirational lifestyle copy. The interface is a knowledgeable intermediary between the customer and the product, and it gets out of the way.

The palette is grounded in a single deep forest green that signals trust without coldness. Surfaces are clean and light; the green appears only where it matters: the primary action, the price, the active state. Everything else is tinted neutral. Cards have a gentle hover elevation to confirm they're interactive, not to decorate.

This system explicitly rejects: the generic WooCommerce white-and-blue ecommerce default, the all-caps-serif luxury boutique, the SaaS startup gradient-hero, and the overcrowded marketplace grid.
keyCharacteristics: Single green accent, used sparingly, always meaningful
Syne headlines, DM Sans body: authority plus clarity
Cards flat at rest, lightly lifted on hover
Prices complete, never truncated, in tabular numerals
Every touch target minimum 44px; layout starts at 375px

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Verde Mendocino appears on primary buttons, active nav items, prices, and positive numbers. Nowhere else.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every gray is tinted toward green. Hoja Oscura over slate-900, Menta Tenue over gray-100.

rules.name: The Syne-is-Authority Rule
rules.body: Syne appears only where TechPhone is speaking with its own voice: the store name, page titles, hero headings, and large stat numbers.

rules.name: The Tabular Price Rule
rules.body: All prices use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. No price ever truncates.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as response to state: hover elevation on cards, glow on primary buttons, blur on the navbar.

dos: Do use Verde Mendocino exclusively for primary CTAs, active states, prices, and positive data.
Do write every price in full with tabular-nums.
Do show condition (NUEVO/USADO) and stock on every product card.
Do use Syne 700/800 for page titles and hero headings only.
Do keep touch targets at minimum 44px height throughout.
Do give financing messaging (cuotas) prominent placement.
donts: Don't use a generic white-and-blue ecommerce layout.
Don't use all-caps serif headings or black/gold color pairs.
Don't add gradient hero backgrounds, particle animations, or SaaS copy.
Don't cram 12 cards edge-to-edge in mobile viewports.
Don't truncate product names or prices with ellipsis.
Don't add splash screens or loading animations inside the dashboard.
Don't use Syne for button labels, form fields, or table data.
Don't use Verde Mendocino as a background on inactive elements.
